text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to hone their skills begins.
Early in the morning on that day—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Good morning.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
How... strange.
Even though we're in the same room.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Solo practice? You're pretty stoic right before the training camp—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, for me... how should I put it,
I just couldn't sit still.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Because 'now' is all... I have.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for interrupting.
Well, I'm off for a run.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... haa...!
...Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Phew...... One more set!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (Miracle-san... Her speed is getting sharper and sharper.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Unless I surpass that person...
I will never reach the heights.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (Why is she... so fast—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, whew...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, in the final stretch,
it seemed to me that she was concerned about her footing.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...It seems you were already aware.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If we leave these concerns unaddressed and continue running,
it could lead to a serious injury.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I recommend wrapping up practice for now and reporting this to a teacher.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's all right! It's not like anything's wrong,
I'm just curious, that's all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because this body is...
just a little bit fragile.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: So fragile...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I told you before that I was born frail, right?
Back then, I was always in the hospital...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And the only reason I'm still alive today, let alone running...
is thanks to everyone who helped me back then.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's because everyone gave me life
that I can be standing here right now...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I run because I want to repay
the immense debt of gratitude I owe.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll win a GⅠ and give it to everyone as a gift.
With this speed I was blessed with—"

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: "You are the culmination of our 'Illustrious Lineage,' possessing speed second to none—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—I definitely want to win the Sprinters Stakes,
where I can make the best use of that speed.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And it has to be now...
It has to be right now...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I know how to handle this body
better than anyone!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for worrying about me.
...You're so kind, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Then... I'm gonna run a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (...We are alike.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Miracle-san also runs on gratitude and duty.
She's running for that reason... and that's precisely why...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: She is so unimaginably fast.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Still... why is that?
Something is bothering me—)

On the first day of summer training camp, Daiichi Ruby seemed somewhat restless...
or so it felt.
Watching her closely to figure out the reason—

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're up early, Miracle!
Training already? Not gonna hang out?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Because I crammed
too much into our schedule."

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
You're always such a hard worker.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... I'm okay.
Thank you."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Now then... Focus.

It seems Daiichi Ruby has her eyes fixed on K.S.Miracle.
I know she sees her as a rival, but—
choice_data_list: (Is there something else bothering her... perhaps?)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...During this training camp, that person—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...No, let us attain a speed second to none.
